actions.description: Reset the CBF demo simulation through the ResetSim service: the node returns to its initial position, replans the trajectory and recreates its 10 Hz timer. The done flag acknowledges the callback, not a stopped state.

inputs.description: ResetSim request field; the pinned callback is invoked for either value
inputs.name: reset

inputs.description: CBF cautiousness parameter passed to ResetSim; the clone states no numeric range
inputs.name: cbf_param

actions.name: reset_sim

outputs.description: True when the ResetSim callback returned done=true
outputs.name: done

facts.text: The CBF node declares start_pose, my_id and cbf_param ROS parameters and reads cbf_param as a double; the launch value 15.0 is a configurable parameter, not a numeric bound.
The CBF node imports ResetSim from tutorial_interfaces.srv.
The CBF node creates a ResetSim service on the constructed relative name /drone<my_id>/ResetSim.
ResetSim.srv declares request fields reset (bool), cbf_param (float32) and response field done (bool).
reset_callback resets i, updates cbf_param when the request differs, regenerates the trajectory and LQR sequence, zeros tru_pose, destroys and recreates the timer, and sets response.done=True.
The launch file runs drone_cbf_sim in namespace drone1 with start_pose [0, 0, 0], my_id 1 and cbf_param 15.0.
The CBF node creates a nav_msgs/Odometry publisher on the relative true_pose topic with queue size 1.
The CBF node creates a 10 Hz timer, and its callback reads the precomputed trajectory, publishes the pose and increments the trajectory index.
The CBF README says the CBF parameter controls cautiousness, the default is 15, and running the client resets the simulation to the initial state.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned-response fake with a placeholder pose and one reset transition; no trajectory generation, LQR integration, CBF solve, timer pacing or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in, not a recording of captured traffic: it runs no CBF node, trajectory generator, LQR controller, obstacle detector, 10 Hz timer, RViz or ROS graph
the pose and twist are placeholder values; the fake changes the pose on ResetSim but integrates no trajectory and makes no arrival or motion claim
the real node steps on a 10 Hz timer; the fake does not advance between observations
the node exposes no pause or stop service or action: ResetSim resets the trajectory and recreates the timer and is not a safe state; a stock e-stop cannot be confirmed and remains latched
the CBF optimization, obstacle/remote-id paths, multi-drone launch, LQR dynamics and trajectory generation are NOT COVERED

ResetSim is advertised under /drone<my_id>/ResetSim; the launch uses /drone1/ResetSim while this binding configures /ResetSim, so a deployment must remap the service (a deployment assumption, not an upstream fact)

measures.description: nav_msgs/Odometry pose selected from the true_pose topic
measures.name: pose

measures.description: nav_msgs/Odometry twist selected from the true_pose topic
measures.name: twist

operator_required.name: reset_sim
operator_required.reason: the CBF node declares cbf_param 15.0 as a configurable ROS parameter and states no numeric range for it; the operator supplies the deployed cautiousness bound

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop is declared: ResetSim resets the CBF trajectory and recreates the 10 Hz timer, so the simulated drone resumes; the node exposes no pause or stop service or action and no safe state is claimed.
